### Unpacking a crampingtexs column
```{r}
nlp_table <- tbl(con, "visits_nlp_tier1")
our.features <- nlp_table %>% select(visit_id, starts_with("nlp_mean_coherence")) %>% select(visit_id, contains("Tpi")) %>%  
  select(visit_id, contains(c("nlp_mean_coherence_sentence_GloVe", "nlp_mean_coherence_sentence_USE", "sentence_BERT_", "sentence_ELMo" ))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("nlp_mean"), names_to="feature_name", values_to="feature_value") %>% 
  collect() %>% 
  separate_wider_regex(feature_name, c("nlp_", feat=".+", "_", "crampingtexs"=".+")) %>% # split out the crampingtexs part of the feature column name 
  unpack_crampingtexs(crampingtexs)
  

```
Now let's look at a specific feature:

```{r}
our.features %>% filter(!is.na(feature_value) & visit_id=="006ee59854-6-29-20" & feat=="mean_coherence_sentence_BERT_interwindow")
```

So we can see from this that the same original recording has led to three BERT-based sentence coherence scores (mean_coherence_sentence_BERT_interwindow): the metric was computed over the transcript of the entire recording (the row with "none" for R and "combined" for S), as well as once for the parts of the transcript that corresponded to the speech from each of the two speakers the PyAnnote diarizer identified (as per the R value). 
We don't know which one is the patient and which is the examiner/interlocutor, at least I don't think so.

### get ss assessments
```{r}
tbl_ss_raw <- tbl(con,"visits_assessments") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("extract")) %>% 
  select( visit_id, starts_with("spon")) %>% #, contains(c("grandftr_status"," grandftr_com", "")) 
  collect

tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select(ptid, visit_id,  race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
```

### clean up demo

```{r}
demographics <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  replace_gender(gender)%>%
  replace_race(race) %>%
  replace_eth(eth) %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>%
  replace_medicaid(medicaid) %>%
  further_diagnosis(diagnosis) %>%
  enumerate_diagnosis(further_diag) %>% 
  fill_in(gender, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(eth, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(race, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(medicaid, new_id) %>% 
  mutate(age  = as.integer(age))
```


### rm fully empty fields 
```{r}
cleaned_ss <- raw_ss_data %>% 
  select(visit_id, contains(c( "coherence")) ) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(contains('Tss'), is.na))
```

### constrained to only comparing the different large langauage models and crampingtexs based on mean_coherence_sentence
```{r}
contrained_ss <- cleaned_ss %>% 
  select(
         contains(c("nlp_mean_coherence_sentence", "visit_id")),
         -contains(c('intrawindow_coherence', "Ss1", "Ss2", "Ss0")) ) %>% #, "Ss1", "Ss2"
  filter_out(if_all(contains('Tss'), is.na))
```

```{r}
contrained_more_ss <- contrained_ss %>% 
  select(contains(c("CmaRnoAorMbiPauIidNorGagTssEclXwx", "visit"))) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(contains('Tss'), is.na))
```

```{r}
ss_cols <- data.frame(colSums(is.na(contrained_more_ss)))
```

### combine cols
```{r}

###combining tables 

ss_total <- inner_join(contrained_more_ss, demographics, by = "visit_id")%>% 
  select(-c(diagnosis, medicaid)) %>% 
  mutate( 
    health_status := factor( case_when(
      further_diag == "HC" ~ "HC",
      further_diag =="AD" ~ "AD",
      .default = "other cases"),
      levels = c("HC", "AD", "other cases" ))
)
```


### demographics
```{r}
no_id <- ss_total %>% 
  select(-c(visit_id,visit_date, num_diagnosis, new_id, ptid, shape, shape_num)) 
  
```

```{r}
table_1 <- tbl_summary(
  no_id,
  by = health_status,
  type = list(where(is.numeric) ~ "continuous"),
  list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
  label = c(list(race = "Race"), 
            list(eth = "Ethnicity"), 
            list(age_group = "Age"), 
            list(gender = "Gender"), 
            list(medicaid = "Medicaid")),
  missing_text = "Missing Values") %>% 
  as_gt()

table_1
```

```{r}
gt::gtsave(table_1, filename = "ss_demo.html")
``` 
